pages.title: Spin Network Node
pages.text: A node of a spin network: a grain of volume, its faces the links that join it to its neighbours. Space is built from these.
Made in $(item)Spin Network Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Loop Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Fixed-Point Lattice, Quantum Spacetime Condensate.
